text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One peaceful afternoon—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No waaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way! Absolutely
no way!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Perfect timing!
You tell Nature too~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
They want us to take a picture
with the 'Promo' Squad together!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Didn't we basically take it upon
ourselves
to be the academy's promo team?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Apparently word of that reached the
Chairwoman's ears.
Soâ

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
We really got appernted!
Make sure you take a super cool photo,
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
And yet Nature says it's impossible!
Whyyy!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean... that's just not like me, and
it's way too heavy a burden for me anyway—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: There's no way!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
They ran!
After them--!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's fine right here!
Go chase after Nature first!
choice_data_list: Wait, they ran in the opposite dir...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So with that,
I hurriedly chased after Nice Nature, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Wait...
Trainer, are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, why is the Trainer the one
chasing me? What happened to Turbo?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hahii... Turbo is... here... 
Nature... found you~...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
why are you completely exhausted too?!
What kind of development is this?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hahh... you too, Nature...
We're taking photos...
this is really happening...!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're still on about that...?
Why are you trying so hard anyway?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Because you're not really
trying to run away, Nature...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo knows!
Nature's way faster when she's serious!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
So what you really want is to get caught,
right?
Then Turbo's gonna be 'it' and chase you
down!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, what's that supposed to mean?
Like I'd ever want to get caught...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean,
there's no way I can do that.
I could never
shine brightly like Teio and the others...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Why can't Nature just be on screen as
herself?!
Turbo likes the usual Nature best!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally!
Let's take one together, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You guys... why?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We have a promotional photoshoot now,
right?
I just heard about it from Turbo-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...!
Could it be you brought the two of them for
my sake...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Nature, look, look!
Model pose! Nyun!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nyu...?
Wait, a model for what?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
After much agonizing,
this is my all-out pose.
Would you like to try it too, Nature?
It helps you relax your shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh.
That's...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature, you're happy, right?!
We're all together,
so of course you wanna take one, right?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft, honestly, guys.
You're all trying way too hard.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...If I turn it down now,
it'll make me look like the bad guy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
Twin Turbo and the others went into
the Academy promotional photoshoot
togetherâ

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Awe-awesome!
Turbo and the gang look so cool!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's embarrassing, so stop staring!
Jeez...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Natureee! We put up tons of photos of us
all over the Academy and the town!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugyaaaah--?!
Aw jeez,
I knew I shouldn't have taken that photo!!
